data.long_meaning: The name Garson is an Old English name derived from the words 'Gar' and 'son'. 'Gar' means 'spear', and 'son' means 'son'. Thus, Garson can be translated to mean 'Son of a spear'. Historically, this name may have been given to a warrior or to a child born during a time of war. The name Garson carries the meaning “Son of a spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garson usually hope their child will grow to embody son of a spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It was a name given to individuals who were associated with war, strength, and protection. knights, warriors, and soldiers often bore this name, reflecting the bravery and valor of these individuals.
